properties.description: Pre-reaction contact complex of the exo channel: HCNO lying over the C4=C5 face ANTI to the methano bridge C10 (B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, 0 imaginary frequencies).
Concerted asynchronous [3+2] saddle of the exo channel: C(nitrile)-C4 2.21 A, O-C5 2.48 A, isoxazoline ring on the face opposite to C10. Barrier 16.18 kcal/mol above RC_exo.
exo/anti diastereomer: 2-isoxazoline fused at C4-C5 with the ring on the face opposite to the methano bridge C10 (0 imaginary frequencies). Isomeric SMILES derived from the optimized 3D geometry.
Pre-reaction contact complex of the endo channel: HCNO over the C4=C5 face SYN to the methano bridge C10 (0 imaginary frequencies). 0.47 kcal/mol above RC_exo.
Concerted asynchronous [3+2] saddle of the endo channel: C(nitrile)-C4 2.26 A, O-C5 2.47 A, ring on the same side as C10. Barrier 10.77 kcal/mol above RC_endo.
endo/syn diastereomer: 2-isoxazoline fused at C4-C5 with the ring on the same side as the methano bridge C10 (0 imaginary frequencies). Isomeric SMILES derived from the optimized 3D geometry.
